investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-28T16:23–16:24Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production API's POST /api/agents call could not reach the swarm gateway ELB at /v1/agents. Because the failure is shared across every sibling check with the same error message and zero evidence was collected, the fault is localized to the swarm gateway layer, not to individual eval logic or the eval runner itself.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting /v1/agents) was unreachable from the production API at the time of the eval run. Every POST /api/agents request returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning", preventing agent creation from starting and leaving all required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) completely absent. This is an eval-detected infrastructure availability failure localized to the swarm gateway dependency; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so broader production impact cannot be confirmed from this packet alone.
